dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I suppose I've finally managed to help Khedive with this dark mud problem of his...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #...Ah, {NICKNAME}, hello! How is your day going?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Now that I think about it, you truly have been a big help to me a great many times.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: The business with the Energy Amplifier, our observations of that special Ruin Grader on Tsurumi Island, and now again here at The Chasm.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Each time, it was always some kind of emergency or highly complicated matter, which was then resolved wonderfully by your presence.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Honestly, I wonder if it's your luck that's good, or if it is my good fortune bumping into you so often...

choices.text: So, how are those memoirs going?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Heh, I mean, I was just saying it ... I still have a long way to go before my achievements are anything worth writing a memoir about.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: What's more, there are still many research topics left for me to tackle... and the more I tackle, the more I'll be able to write in my memoirs.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: A such, I'm of the view that the later you write your memoirs, the better.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Do you mean to ask why I accepted his commission to help him out here at The Chasm?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Do you know of the Purbiruni? Khedive is from that school of researchers.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: When I was at the Akademiya, I received quite a lot of help from that school, and so you can consider this a returning of that favor.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I mean, it's just normal to have such relationships, right? And in any case, no one school of researchers can solve all problems by themselves. That's why there's a need for collaboration!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It is how we bond as researchers.

choices.text: Well, all the best, then. See you!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: All the best to you too!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, I'm hoping that things will turn out for the best, at least...
